slides.texte_overlay:
how to improve your brain
health
Sleep seven to nine hours. Sleep is when your brain recovers and stores memories. Short nights slowly make you slower, foggier and more irritable.
Train your body regularly. Running, lifting, swimming. Exercise boosts blood flow to the brain and helps your mood, focus and memory.
Eat more omega-3 foods. Salmon, sardines, walnuts, chia seeds. Your brain uses these healthy fats every day. Plan one real meetup every week, even a short coffee.
Stay social. Real conversations with friends and family keep your mind active and protect you from stress and loneliness. Social time is brain time.
Before: my brain only got short videos. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it feels more awake and curious.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my brain only got short videos. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It feels more awake and curious.

slides.texte_overlay: Manage your stress. A walk, deep breathing, time in nature. Long-term stress is tiring for your brain, so build calm into your week.
Protect your head. Wear a helmet on the bike, be careful in contact sports. Your brain has to last you a lifetime. Look after it like the most precious thing you own.
